q1.explanationZh: 原文说由于微重力环境，宇航员洗脸刷牙的方式和我们在地面上不同，他们用面巾洗脸。

evidence.quote: they do these in a different way from us here on the ground

q2.explanationZh: 原文说宇航员“有时”（Sometimes）出舱进行太空行走，并不是每天。

evidence.quote: Sometimes they go out for a “spacewalk!”

q3.explanationZh: 原文说宇航员每天吃早餐、午餐和晚餐，即一日三餐。

evidence.quote: Astronauts eat breakfast, lunch and dinner every day.

q4.explanationZh: 睡袋固定在墙上，所以宇航员整晚不会飘来飘去。

evidence.quote: so they won’t float around all night

q5.explanationZh: 宇航员可以用微波炉加热食物（1-B）；睡袋固定在墙上（2-C）；他们把牙膏直接挤进嘴里刷牙，刷完还可以吃掉牙膏（3-D）；检查支持系统是为了让“家”保持良好状态（4-A）。

evidence.quote: They can also heat their food in a microwave oven.
The sleeping bags are attached to the wall
They can even eat their toothpaste!
to keep their “home” in good shape, like checking support systems
